+Happy Versalmas to You#4998
Now that I have Little Suzy's Wishlist, I need to give it to either Maple Claws or O-Pongo. I should go see O-Pongo in New Leaf City if I want to give it to him. Decisions, decisions... I'm thinking it's Versalmas for me this year! All I have to do now to cement my decision is to actually give Little Suzy's Wishlist to O-Pongo. I can't wait! It's time for a change of pace! Looks like I'm celebrating Versalmas this year! I gave Little Suzy's Wishlist to O-Pongo, and he gave me this awesome Versalmas Hat for me to wear proudly! Every time I bring O-Pongo presents I've collected from monsters, he'll reward me; I'll now be able to redeem presents to him in batches of 10, 20, 30, 40, 60, 90, or 100. I'll get different rewards at different tiers; the more presents I bring at one time, the better the rewards! I'll need to bring him presents appropriate to my level though. Bringing O-Pongo more presents will also help me earn Versalmas Cheer! If the total amount of Versalmas Cheer accumulated on my world beats out the total amount of Maplemas Spirit, O-Pongo will have something really nice for me at the end of the event!

~Brand Materia#4924
AreaEvent · Lv.10
Area30→50
RegionVictoria Island→Event
NPC→The Glimmer Man
Level Requirement—→10
Chain Length—→2
Rewardsnone→1 exp, 1 item
Description
a b c
Looks like the Glimmer Man is looking for a rare material from the alternate dimension of Versal, the very White Versal Materia that I now possess. Perhaps I should visit him in New Leaf City and see what he wants with it. Maybe he'll reward me for bringing him some... I visited the Glimmer Man, and discovered that he's an ultra-powerful mage whose ability to turn his entire body into pure diamond (hence his name) has allowed him to journey to space and other inhospitable environments. Through the vast knowledge he's acquired during his explorations, he's also become somewhat of a renowned weapons creator and arms dealer. The Glimmer Man has landed in Masteria looking for something called White Versal Materia, a rare element from the alternate dimension of Versal he's been dying to experiment with. To thank me for recovering some and bringing it to him, he's promised to make me a weapon of my own from it. However, I've got to also track down 7 Black Crystals and return these to him as well. Only then can he reduce the naturally unstable Materia down to a useable form. A weapon made from an otherwordly material! I wonder what it does... I returned to the Glimmer Man and he synthesized the White Versal Materia and the 7 Black Crystals I gave him to form a Materia Orb. He's said his precocious friend Spindle can turn this into a weapon, so I should see him when I'm ready to make the weapon...WOOT! Spindle is currently residing in the Omega Sector. Additionally, anytime I find more White Versal Materia, I can bring it to the Glimmer Man and he'll create another Materia Orb for me so I can make another weapon!
~Brand Materia Continued#4925

The document that contains all the mysterious skills necessary to become the Master. I found all the loose pages, but Do Gong looked concerned as he ran through The Book Ghost's Sheet of Paper. What's the problem now When will he make me a Master I better talk to Do Gong. After looking through The Book Ghost's Sheet of Paper, Do Gong stated that there were cat footprints everywhere, and concluded that some street cats may have read the document and secretly obtained those skills. Vikin of Lith Harbor apparently has been waiting for the right time to do something big.. Vikin seemed eager to fight the stormy sea, and wanted me to find Pirate Map, the map that featured the secret path through the stormy sea. According to Vikin, the one that has all 6 divided pieces of Piece of the Pirate Map happens to be the only person that has survived the stormy sea, Lord Pirate… Hey, that means I have to go through the lair of Lord Pirate! Piece of the Pirate Map 4001118/6 I was able to gather up all the Piece of the Pirate Maps from the lair of Lord Pirate and gave them to Vikin. Obtaining the map, Vikin seemed ecstatic to finally be able to tackle on the stormy sea. I mean, he's acutely aware of the dangers that lurks over him, and yet he seemed to eager to attack the water. Vikin really must be one heck of a traveler.

Description
There's a new sheriff in New Leaf City. I should go see who it is! I met the new sheriff, Lita Lawless. She's an old friend of Icebyrd's, and has taken over as the new sheriff. I've agreed to help her get this town in order, by wiping out 200 Electrophants and 200 Gryphons in New Leaf City. I'd better get started! I...I did it! 200 of Electrophants and Gryphons has fallen to my might! In addition to that, I got a cool item from Lita as a ‘Thank You!’ I can return and help her anytime I want from now on...

AreaVictoria Island · Lv.40
Description
The 'best-dressed' lady of Mushroom Shrine, Hanako, seems to be perturbed at something... I found Hanako enraged - it appears her newly-purchased fabric was destroyed by a pack of Dark Cloud Foxes. For someone as vain as she is, this is devastating. As a result, I promised her to eliminate 100 Dark Cloud Foxes for her. The things I do for friends... Dark Cloud Fox 43051# Hanako seemed thankful for me eliminating 100 Dark Cloud Foxs. She must have bought some new fabric already.
The 'best-dressed' lady of Mushroom Shrine, Hanako, seems to be perturbed at something... I found Hanako enraged - it appears her newly-purchased fabric was destroyed by a pack of Big Cloud Foxes. For someone as vain as she is, this is devastating. As a result, I promised her to eliminate 100 Big Cloud Foxes for her. The things I do for friends... Big Cloud Fox 43051# Hanako seemed thankful for me eliminating 100 Big Cloud Foxs. She must have bought some new fabric already.
~Hanako's Foxtail Muffler 1#4302
AreaVictoria Island · Lv.25
Description
Hanako of Mushroom Shrine has an item she really would love to have. What must that be It turns out that the item Hanako wants to have is a muffler made out of Cloud Foxtail. A muffler made out of Foxtails. Hmm…I don't get why she'd want to wear a muffler in such warm weather, but I did promise to get her Cloud Foxtails, She needs 100, so I'd better get started. So, that's 100 Cloud Foxtails... Cloud Foxtail 4000066/100 I gave Hanako 100 Cloud Foxtails. Hmmm, but this isn't as much as I thought. Can she really make a muffler out of this

You can solve Rain's Quizzes if you carefully think about it. Rain's 4th Quiz was finding the hot-key for picking up the items on the ground. That's easy~ it's " Z" of course~ But I found out I can also pick up items with the number key "0"...

~Subani's Legacy - Deliverance#4915
AreaMasteria · Lv.44
Description
John has finished deciphering the markings! I need to get back to the Temple Hive now! John and I spoke again, and something unforeseen happened. I’ll have to track down 50 MesoGears Map Pieces so he can put together the map! He mentioned the robots he “borrowed” for some assistance went all crazy, kept saying “I.AM.ROBOT” as they scurried into the Krakian Jungle... Finally done! I took the pieces back to John, and he's going to start piecing the map together. However, he did come across a strange ring that passed on to me. If this was the first treasure, I wonder where the rest is...

AreaMasteria · Lv.36
Description
I heard there's an adventurer over at the MesoGears underneath Bigger Ben. What mysteries does it hold I should find out! I spoke with the famous John Barricades' one-half of the world famous Barricade Bros. Treasure Hunting Co. He spoke to me about Subani, the legendary mage responsible for the Dark Scrolls throughout the Maple World. He believes there is something within the MesoGears that may be a treasure of his. I’ve agreed to help clear the way. I’ll have to defeat 50 Killa Bees, 30 Mighty Maple Eaters and 40 Fire Tusks so I can explore deeper into the MesoGears... I cleared a path straight through the MesoGears, and now I can explore there in peace. When I'm ready, I can see John Barricade to continue with the next part of this adventure!

He spoke to me about Subani, the legendary mage responsible for the Dark Scrolls throughout the Maple World. He believes there is something within the MesoGears that may be a treasure of his. I've agreed to help clear the way. I'll have to defeat 50 Killa Bees, 30 Mighty Maple Eaters and 40 Fire Tusks so I can explore deeper into the MesoGears... I cleared a path straight through the MesoGears, and now I can explore there in peace. When I'm ready, I can see John Barricade to continue with the next part of this adventure!
~The Ingredients for the Flying Pill#2086

AreaMasteria · Lv.80
Description
There's a Masked Man in New Leaf City... what's his deal I spoke with Jack Masque, he’s a bandit prince from Amoria. He’s in love with Princess Restless, and is trying to win her love from afar. He’s got a passionate hatred for Wolf Spiders, as one bit her just as she was giving him a kiss. So, I’ve agreed to hunt down 100 Wolf Spiders in return for his thanks and something special he picked up. I should be able to find them in the MesoGears... +Phew* I wiped out 100 of those pesky Wolf Spiders, and in return, I received a Leaf Crystal from Jack Masque. I can come back every 72 hours to help him if I want. I wonder what he did to get kicked out of Amoria...
